description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component, specifically testing the load functionality of the Rialto client media pipeline. It defines a test fixture class and two test cases to verify success and failure scenarios of the load method, using mock expectations.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineLoadTest
classes.description: A test fixture class derived from MediaPipelineTestBase, used to test the load functionality of the media pipeline.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates the media pipeline.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment and destroys the media pipeline.
